repos.description: Repo for counting stars and contributing. Press F to pay respect to glorious developers.
repos.summary_zh: 996.ICU 是一个由程序员发起的倡议，旨在揭露和抵制中国科技行业盛行的 '996' 工作制（早9点至晚9点，每周6天），倡导劳动者权益保护。项目通过开源社区收集侵权企业黑名单、推广反996许可证，并推动建立尊重员工权益的工作文化。
repos.summary_en: 996.ICU is a developer-led initiative exposing and resisting the '996' work schedule (9am-9pm, 6 days/week) in China's tech industry. It builds an open-source blacklist of violators, promotes the Anti-996 License, and advocates for worker rights through community-driven transparency and legal tools.

repos.description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布
repos.summary_zh: 《科技爱好者周刊》是阮一峰团队推出的科技内容周刊，每周五发布，聚焦前沿科技趋势、AI应用、创业洞察与行业动态，内容涵盖人工智能、互联网经济、软件开发等领域，兼具深度与可读性，是科技从业者与爱好者的重要资讯来源。
repos.summary_en: The Tech Enthusiast Weekly is a curated publication by Ruan YiFeng, releasing every Friday with in-depth coverage of emerging technologies, AI advancements, startup insights, and industry trends, targeting tech professionals and enthusiasts seeking actionable intelligence.

repos.description: 本文原文由知名 Hacker Eric S. Raymond 所撰寫，教你如何正確的提出技術問題並獲得你滿意的答案。
repos.summary_zh: 本指南由知名黑客 Eric S. Raymond 撰写，系统阐述高效提问的技术沟通原则，涵盖问题筛选、论坛选择、标题撰写、代码呈现等关键技巧，帮助开发者获得精准解答，提升开源社区协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Authored by renowned hacker Eric S. Raymond, this guide systematically outlines principles for effective technical communication, covering question selection, forum choice, title writing, and code presentation to help developers obtain accurate answers and improve open-source community collaboration.

repos.description: wtfpython的中文翻译/持续🚧.../ 能力有限，欢迎帮我改进翻译
repos.summary_zh: wtfpython-cn 是经典项目 wtfpython 的中文翻译版，旨在揭示 Python 中鲜为人知但令人困惑的特性与反直觉行为。通过一系列精心设计的示例，帮助开发者深入理解语言底层机制，涵盖字符串处理、操作符误用、对象身份与相等性、生成器行为等核心议题，适合进阶学习或规避常见陷阱。
repos.summary_en: wtfpython-cn is the Chinese translation of the renowned wtfpython project, exposing obscure yet counterintuitive Python behaviors. Through curated examples, it demystifies core language mechanics—such as string quirks, operator pitfalls, object identity, and generator nuances—making it ideal for intermediate to advanced developers seeking deeper Python mastery.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的开源项目清单
repos.summary_zh: 编程随想维护的开源项目收藏清单，涵盖C/C++和Python两大语言的技术库与示例代码，聚焦程序员实用工具与学习资源，便于快速检索与参考。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of open-source projects by Programthink, featuring code libraries and examples in C/C++ and Python, designed for developers to quickly access practical tools and learning resources.
